lab.name: MMBS Laboratory
lab.institution: Department of Chemical Engineering · IIT Kharagpur
lab.intro: We combine chemical engineering, biology and computation to develop microfluidic chips, engineered tissues, biomaterials and biosensors for healthcare research.
about: Based in Chemical Engineering at IIT Kharagpur, the lab connects microfluidics, biomaterials, biological interfaces and sensing with computational modelling, AI and advanced manufacturing.

Our platforms include lab and organ chips, 3D-bioprinted tissue and disease models, functional biomaterials, biosensors and multiscale simulations. Applications include disease modelling, drug discovery, immunotherapy, tissue engineering, regeneration and precision medicine. Microfabrication and translational biology help turn engineering models into predictive tools for healthcare.
We welcome research partnerships with universities, hospitals, institutes and industry.

projects.title: Lymph node-on-a-chip for cancer vaccines
projects.description: Models the lymph-node paracortex and declining immune function with age to evaluate cancer-vaccine responses in older patients, who are less represented in preclinical studies.

projects.title: Glioblastoma-on-a-chip
projects.description: Recreates the cellular and mechanical conditions of brain tissue in a 3D glioblastoma model to investigate treatment resistance and candidate therapies.

projects.title: Vascularized organ & tumor chips
projects.description: Brain and tumour organoids with vascular networks for studies of aging, neuroinflammation and personalised immuno-oncology treatments, in collaboration with Duke University School of Medicine.

people.name: Dr. Surjendu Maity
people.role: Assistant Professor & Principal Investigator, Department of Chemical Engineering, IIT Kharagpur
people.bio: Dr. Maity combines chemical engineering, nanotechnology and bioengineering to develop organ and organoid chips, lab-on-a-chip devices and biosensors for human-relevant disease and treatment studies.

timeline.label: PhD
timeline.text: Nanotechnology at IIT Guwahati with Prof. Dipankar Bandyopadhyay; microfluidic transport, sensing and delivery of nanoscale objects.

timeline.label: Postdoc
timeline.text: Terasaki Institute for Biomedical Innovation, Los Angeles, with Prof. Ali Khademhosseini; cancer-vaccine screening and glioblastoma drug resistance using organ chips.

timeline.label: Postdoc
timeline.text: Duke University School of Medicine with Prof. Shyni Varghese; aging-brain models and vascularised tumour organoids on chips.

timeline.label: Current
timeline.text: Assistant Professor of Chemical Engineering at IIT Kharagpur and Principal Investigator of the MMBS Laboratory.
